scope: Two preselected, clustered H1 CPU qualification outputs only; no injection population, background population, FAR or selection-efficiency validation.

method.identity: detector, exact signed template hash, round(end_time * sample_rate); no fuzzy matching
method.formula: r = chisq/(2*stored_chisq_dof-2); newSNR = snr for r<=1, else snr*[0.5*(1+r^3)]^(-1/6)
method.arithmetic: float64 from stored values; float32 getter sensitivity also checked
method.rank: 1 is highest; ties resolved by signed template hash then GPS tick
method.rank_improvement: original rank minus proposed rank; positive means moved up
method.retention: post-hoc newSNR >= threshold within saved outputs; unavailable rows have no inferred score
